_comment: Lines in a tracked Dockerfile that check_docker_npm_pins.py must forgive.
Keyed '<path>:<the EXACT stripped line>'. Exact, not a substring: under substring
matching a shorter key claims every longer line that contains it. Every reason must
start with BLOCKER: and say what makes that line different -- and the gate REFUSES
an entry that matches nothing, so a stale exclusion reds instead of sitting there
Empty since 2026-09-30: the two private/account/Dockerfile `npm install` entries
rested on an EUSAGE that was a layout artefact (the lockfile's ../../packages/shared
key resolved from /app), and both stages now run npm ci from /repo/private/account.
